title: Two Rooks, Two Directions
setup: Black's king is loose on g2, with a bishop on d3 beside your queen and a rook waiting on d8.
hint: Neither rook mates on its own. Find the order in which each one takes a square the other cannot.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rb2+}} takes the second rank, {{Rg4+}} takes the g-file, and with both gone {{Qc1#}} mates along the first rank. Rooks hunt in pairs by covering perpendicular lines.
